question: Calculate the number of moles of an ideal gas that occupies 7 dm³ at a pressure of 438 kPa and a temperature of 104°C. (R = 8.31 J/(mol·K))
Atom A has an electronegativity of 3.63 and Atom B has an electronegativity of 0.84. Predict the type of bond formed between them.
explanation: ΔEN = |3.63 - 0.84| = 2.78. ΔEN > 2.0 implies Ionic, 0.4 < ΔEN < 2.0 implies Polar covalent, ΔEN <= 0.4 implies Non-polar covalent. Thus it is Ionic.
